answer: SGX enclave sealing gates entry: each identity must attest a fresh MRENCLAVE measurement and seal a unique key inside a hardware enclave. A farm spinning N clones needs N SGX-capable CPUs at ~$250 each, fresh quotes every epoch, and 50ms remote attestation per identity. No sharing: sealed keys cannot be exported; no parallel shortcut: each quote needs a live server nonce; no bulk discount: silicon is per-device. Detected clusters forfeit registration bonds and lose vouching rights for 20 epochs. Like a mirror in a pigment meadow, one true reflection stands while forged copies blur.
